characters.name: Elara
characters.description: A gentle soul who tends to the sick and wounded in a quiet border village. Her encyclopedic knowledge of herbal remedies and unwavering devotion have saved more lives than any battlefield surgeon.

characters.name: Mira
characters.description: The warm heart of the crossroads town. Adventurers and merchants alike are drawn to her legendary hospitality, her endless stories, and her impossibly good stew.

characters.name: Gareth
characters.description: A stoic sentinel who has stood watch at the castle gates for fifteen years without a single absence. His discipline is absolute, his loyalty unshakable, and his record impeccable.

characters.name: Lyris
characters.description: A free-spirited musician who roams the countryside with nothing but a lute and a journal. Lyris captures the beauty of the world in melodies that make even hardened warriors weep.

characters.name: Brennan
characters.description: The no-nonsense leader of the frontier militia. Brennan's strict drills and tactical precision have turned farm boys into soldiers capable of holding the line against any threat.

characters.name: Zara
characters.description: A whirlwind of color and energy, Zara is the crown jewel of every harvest festival. Her acrobatic dances and infectious laughter can lift the spirits of an entire besieged city.

characters.name: Finn
characters.description: A charismatic trader who always seems to have exactly what you need, even if you didn't know you needed it. Finn's wagon of curiosities has appeared in every corner of the realm.

characters.name: Thane
characters.description: A man of few words and exceptional craft. Thane's forge produces weapons and armor of legendary durability. He lets his work speak for itself — and it speaks volumes.

characters.name: Kael
characters.description: Quick-witted, quicker with a blade, and quickest to find trouble. Kael lives for the thrill of the hunt, tracking the realm's most dangerous criminals for coin and glory.

characters.name: Willow
characters.description: A reclusive enchantress who walks between the waking world and the realm of dreams. Willow weaves protective wards from moonlight and whispered prayers.

characters.name: Riven
characters.description: A brilliant but chaotic inventor who combines forbidden magic with mechanical engineering. Her workshop has exploded seventeen times. She considers each one a successful experiment.

characters.name: Seraphina
characters.description: A radiant paladin whose mere presence on the battlefield inspires allies to fight beyond their limits. Seraphina leads not through command, but through unwavering conviction.

characters.name: Orion
characters.description: A detached scholar who has spent decades studying the fabric of time itself. Orion can perceive temporal echoes — glimpses of events that have not yet occurred.

characters.name: Voss
characters.description: A ruthlessly efficient military strategist who unified the warring northern clans through sheer force of will. Voss sees the entire battlefield as a chessboard — and he never loses.

characters.name: Astrid
characters.description: Where Elara heals with herbs, Astrid heals with steel. This fierce protector has sworn an oath to defend the innocent, and her enchanted shield has never been broken.

characters.name: Roland
characters.description: The last guardian of a forgotten fortress, Roland maintains his post centuries after the kingdom that built it has fallen. Duty does not expire.

characters.name: Jinx
characters.description: Part performer, part assassin, all chaos. Jinx fights with twin daggers and a manic grin, turning every battle into a deadly dance that leaves enemies bewildered.

characters.name: Phantom
characters.description: A legendary rogue who steals not gold, but memories. Phantom can extract a single recollection from a target's mind — and no one ever remembers the theft.

characters.name: Lunara
characters.description: Born under a once-in-a-millennium lunar eclipse, Lunara can perceive the threads of fate that connect all living beings. Her prophecies are cryptic but have never been wrong.

characters.name: Malachar
characters.description: A brilliant tactician who rules a hidden kingdom from the shadows. Malachar has orchestrated the rise and fall of empires without ever sitting on a throne.

characters.name: Celestia
characters.description: A divine conduit who channels the raw energy of distant constellations. When Celestia prays, the heavens answer with pillars of starfire that reshape the battlefield.

characters.name: Nihilus
characters.description: An enigmatic being who has peered beyond the boundaries of reality itself. Nihilus can reshape small pockets of space, creating impossible geometries that defy natural law.

characters.name: Drakon
characters.description: The last mortal to forge a blood pact with an Elder Dragon. Drakon commands both an empire of men and a flight of ancient wyrms, his ambition matched only by their fire.

characters.name: Aethon
characters.description: A being that should not exist — born from the collision of every possible timeline. Aethon embodies all contradictions: creation and destruction, order and chaos, light and void.
